newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: OSCE envoy Vranitzky to Albania on Thursday.
newsitem.headline: OSCE envoy Vranitzky to Albania on Thursday.

text.p: European envoy Franz Vranitzky is to return to Albania on Thursday to hold talks with political leaders, a spokeswoman for the Organisation for Security and Cooperation in Europe (OSCE) said.

Vranitzky, who heads an OSCE mission set up after widespread violence broke out in the Balkan state in March, was due to leave Austria at 6.30 a.m. local time (0430 GMT) but the agenda for his one-day visit had not yet been formulated, the spokeswoman said.
Vranitzky last week brokered an agreement between Albania's bickering political parties to work towards drafting a new electoral law for a general election planned for June 29.

But President Sali Berisha's Democratic Party forced an election law through the Democrat-dominated parliament on Tuesday, angering other parties who say they may boycott the general election as they did during the last ballot last year.

The decision by parliament was considered a snub to the OSCE and Vranitzky who pressed for a new electoral law backed by all parties in the interim national unity government set up in March after rioting and killing spread across the country.
